audit_items.proof_trace: Deposit validation failures wrapped in execReqErr are explicitly excluded from invalidBlock conversion at receive_block.go:516-517. When IsExecutionRequestError returns true, the error bypasses the invalidBlock wrapper on line 519, violating the postcondition that all invalid deposits must raise InvalidBlock.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends block containing nil deposit request via P2P. processDepositRequest returns error wrapped in execReqErr. receive_block.go:516 detects execReqErr and returns unwrapped error instead of invalidBlock, allowing invalid block to fail processing without proper consensus rejection.
